structure.unit: Virginia Professional Limited Liability Company Act

law.catch_line: Application of Chapter 12 of this title
law.text: The provisions of Chapter 12 (§ 13.1-1000 et seq.) of this title shall be applicable to professional limited liability companies organized under the provisions of this chapter. Where a conflict arises between the provisions found in Chapter 12 (§ 13.1-1000 et seq.) of this title and this chapter, this chapter shall control.
